description: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 Omni (text, image, video and audio input) as lukealonso's ModelOpt NVFP4 checkpoint on three Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 3 over Ray, a 1,000,000-token context on a 4-bit NVFP4 KV cache (DiffKV Triton backend with WMMA decode), MTP2 speculative decoding and the TP3 virtual-heads mod that pads the attention heads for three ranks. Basis: tonyd2wild's TP3 NVFP4-KV recipe (MIT) and his earlier TP3 MTP repository (FP8 KV variant, offered as an option), on his published patched vLLM 0.21.1rc1.dev85 dev-build image with the upstream mods applied at build time (the mods are derived from vLLM, Apache-2.0). The upstream TP3 repository does not name an image; the published TP2 image is used because the earlier TP3 repository's audio recipe names the same image lineage (vllm-mimo-omni-mtp2-1m-audio-exp:20260620). The two-Spark recipe by the same creator is mimo-v2-5-omni-nvfp4-tonyd2wild-vllm-dual. Upstream figures (about 36 tok/s decode, 10.59M-token KV pool at 1M context with NVFP4 KV against 3.06M with FP8 KV) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical three-Spark acceptance is pending. Thinking default is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: No server default (upstream TP3 default). Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.89 with no explicit KV pool, tonyd2wild's recipes/mimo-v25-tp3-omni-1mctx-6seq-mtp2-nvfp4kv.yaml at 8024c85b (line 34; lines 93-94 say to keep it fixed at 0.89). The earlier 0.8728 was an offline admission cap (#1985), not a hardware result; 0.89 x 130,663,231,488 plus the 10.4 GB multi-Spark margin estimates 126.69 GB per node, above the admission maximum. The declared peak is the admission maximum, an estimate until the run measures it. The creator context is retained. Physical acceptance remains pending.
title: MiMo V2.5 Omni NVFP4 vLLM three Sparks
